description: This file defines the FooTable.Filter class, which manages filtering logic for a table, including constructing filters, matching strings, and matching table rows.

classes.name: FooTable.Filter
classes.description: Class representing a filter for table data, with methods for matching strings and rows.

methods.name: construct
methods.description: Constructor for FooTable.Filter, initializes filter properties including query, columns, and options.

methods.name: match
methods.description: Checks if the filter matches a given string, converting the query to a FooTable.Query if necessary.

methods.name: matchRow
methods.description: Checks if the filter matches a given table row based on its cells.
